articles.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
articles.summary: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

articles.title: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra
articles.summary: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.
